title: Coherent structure-cohomology comparison before sheafification
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a quasi-compact separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions] and let $q\in\mathbf N$. Assume that the category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules has injective resolutions [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Set $E=R^q f_*\mathcal O_X$ [pqf-def-cohomology]. Use the common sectionwise $\operatorname{ULift}^{u+1}$ coefficient convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be the lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], let $P(U)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}})}(f^{-1}\mathbf Z[U][0],A[q])$ be the raw abelian higher-image group [sbc-lem-higher-direct-image-presheaf] and $r_U:P(U)\to H^q(X_U,j_U^{-1}A)$ its specified restricted evaluation [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology, def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. Then E is quasi-coherent and there is a presheaf morphism $b:P\to E_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison] which is locally injective and locally surjective. For every etale $U\to S$, $a\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ and coefficient endomorphism $\mu:j_U^{-1}A\to j_U^{-1}A$ whose value, under localization, on every test-object section is multiplication by the structural pullback of a, and every $z,z'\in P(U)$, the equality $r_U(z')=H^q(\mu)(r_U(z))$ implies $b_U(z')=\operatorname{ULift.up}(a\cdot\operatorname{ULift.down}(b_U(z)))$. Here $E_{\mathrm{et}}(U)=\operatorname{ULift}^{u+1}\Gamma(U,u^*E)$ with its prescribed tensor-section restrictions and scalar action. Local injectivity means equality of b-images is equality of raw classes after a cover; local surjectivity means every tensor section lifts after a cover.

proof.text: Put E=R^q f_* O_X; it is quasi-coherent. Over an affine etale v:V→S, choose injective resolutions for O_X and its tensor pullback and an augmented comparison lift. The resolution-defined flat-base-change map beta:v^*E→R^q(f_V)_*(j^*O_X) is invertible. Identify j^*O_X with O_X_V by the tensor-unit map. The affine-base cohomology/section comparison identifies the target sections with H^q(X_V,O_X_V). Here X_V is quasi-compact and separated because V is affine and f is quasi-compact separated.

The raw restricted-cohomology evaluation is invertible. Localization identifies its coefficient sheaf with the lifted additive structure sheaf of X_V. Apply the simultaneous pullback-natural etale/Zariski comparison, using the canonical tensor-unit comparison for the structure module. Construct its section coordinates by evaluating that adjoint unit map itself; the tensor-unit restriction equation proves naturality, and the adjunction-unit composition law proves the square for scheme pullback. No unnormalized choice of a structure-sheaf isomorphism is made. Compose with the inverse affine section and flat-base-change comparisons of Step 1 and the explicit sectionwise ULift. For an arrow h:W→V of affine etale objects, raw restriction is precomposition by the pulled-back free-abelian representable map Z[h]. Evaluation at the identity generator sends this to pullback along X_W→X_V: naturality of Yoneda and the sheafification unit moves the generator, and naturality of the derived adjunction unit moves the class. The single/shift comparisons then give the cohomology pullback square. For coefficient maps the recorded raw-evaluation naturality gives the same square. The section formula for beta identifies that same pullback with tensor-section restriction. Composition of adjunction units identifies the comparison for a tower with the composite. Thus the displayed affine maps commute with restrictions.

For an arbitrary etale U, restrict a raw class to affine open subobjects, use the maps of Step 2, and glue in the tensor-section sheaf. On overlaps equality can be checked on affine refinements by Step 2. Uniqueness gives independence of the chosen cover, additivity, and naturality under every etale arrow, giving b. On affine objects b is bijective. Affine etale objects cover every etale object, so these bijections prove local injectivity and local surjectivity of b, including the empty object.

The coefficient normalization in the statement determines mu uniquely: after the localization isomorphism it is multiplication by the pullback of a on every test object. Restrict to an affine open of U. Naturality of raw evaluation restricts the assumed cohomology equality to this open. The scalar clause of the etale/Zariski comparison changes this into multiplication by the pulled-back a in module cohomology. The affine Leray/section comparison and beta are module maps, so it becomes a times the tensor section b(z). The explicit ULift is the same on both sides. Equality on an affine open cover implies the asserted equality on U by the tensor-section sheaf axiom. No positive-rank, nonempty-source, or positive-degree condition is used.

theorem exists_coherent_etale_raw_direct_image_comparison
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] (q : ℕ) :
    let E := (Scheme.Modules.higherDirectImage f q).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    let _ : E.IsQuasicoherent := Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_higherDirectImage f
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) q
    ∃ b : abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf f q X.etaleAdditiveSheaf ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf E).obj,
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective S.smallEtaleTopology b ∧
      Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective S.smallEtaleTopology b ∧
      ∀ (U : S.Etale) (a : Γ(U.left, ⊤))
        (μ : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd U.hom f)).obj
            X.etaleAdditiveSheaf ⟶
          (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd U.hom f)).obj
            X.etaleAdditiveSheaf),
        (∀ (T : (pullback U.hom f).Etale)
          (x : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd U.hom f)).obj
            X.etaleAdditiveSheaf).obj.obj (op T)),
          (((upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (pullback.snd U.hom f) inferInstance).hom.app
              X.etaleAdditiveSheaf).hom.app (op T)) (μ.hom.app (op T) x) =
          ULift.up (@id Γ(T.left, ⊤) ((T.hom ≫ pullback.fst U.hom f).appTop a) *
            (@id Γ(T.left, ⊤) ((((upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (pullback.snd U.hom f) inferInstance).hom.app
                X.etaleAdditiveSheaf).hom.app (op T)) x).down))) →
        ∀ (z z' : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf f q
            X.etaleAdditiveSheaf).obj (op U)),
          rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison f q X.etaleAdditiveSheaf U z' =
            (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback U.hom f) q).map
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map μ))
              (rawRestrictedCohomologyComparison f q X.etaleAdditiveSheaf U z) →
          b.app (op U) z' = ULift.up
            (a • @id Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj E, ⊤)
              (b.app (op U) z).down)
